steps.name: Current Route
steps.expect: Route and/or stations appear per current season rules.

steps.name: Summer Route
steps.expect: Summer Zoomobile stations appear, including **Canadian Domain Zoomobile Station** and **Africa Zoomobile Station** (also **Main**, **Tundra**, and **Eurasia**).

steps.name: Winter Route
steps.expect: Winter Zoomobile stations appear, including **Indo-Malaya Zoomobile Station**; **Canadian Domain Zoomobile Station** and **Africa Zoomobile Station** do not (Main / Tundra / Eurasia may still appear).

steps.name: Station tooltip
steps.do: Click **Main Zoomobile Station** (or another visible Zoomobile station marker).
steps.expect: Tooltip shows that station’s name and description.

steps.name: No leftover arrows
steps.expect: No orphaned route arrows/markers left behind.
